emoji.frequent.description: The heading and category button of the emoji picker's section of the emoji the reader uses most on this device.

emoji.custom.description: The heading and category button of the emoji picker's section of this server's own custom emoji (the only custom emoji a reaction can use).

emoji.group_smileys.description: The heading and category button of a group of Unicode emoji in the emoji picker (one of Unicode's nine groups).

emoji.tone.description: The emoji picker's button and menu that choose the skin tone of the emoji that have one; the five tones are named from Unicode's data.

emoji.tone_default.description: The first choice of the emoji picker's skin tone menu: no tone, the default yellow.

emoji.react.description: The title of the sheet a post's react action opens on a phone, over the emoji picker; the same words as the react action that opens it.

emoji.close.description: The button at the end of the emoji picker sheet's head that closes it without reacting.
